name: review-checks-policy-vector
description: The v0.9.0 anti-rubber-stamp review-checks clause (design §5/§6, contracts/approval.md): a HIGH-RISK approval (declared materialityLevel material|critical) requires BOTH review checks declared true (evidenceInspected AND ruleInspected) — REVIEW_CHECKS_REQUIRED otherwise (fail-closed inside the transaction); normal/NULL never trips the clause (the checks are ignored). The SAME vector file runs from Go (authz.ReviewChecksRequired + authz.ValidateReviewChecks) and TypeScript (authz/approval-policy.ts reviewChecksRequired + validateReviewChecks) and must yield identical outcomes.
